# apple_app_store_versions (Data Source)

Lists an app's App Store versions.

An app accumulates a version record per release for its whole life, one per platform, so `platform` is usually worth setting — it is passed to Apple rather than applied in memory.

The common use is finding the version currently being prepared, so that a localization or review detail can be attached to a release this configuration did not create:

```terraform
data "apple_app_store_versions" "editable" {
  app_id            = data.apple_apps.mine.apps[0].id
  platform          = "IOS"
  app_version_state = "PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION"
}
```

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_apps" "example" {
  bundle_id = "com.example.app"
}

# An app accumulates a version record per release for its whole life, one per
# platform, so platform is usually worth setting -- it is passed to Apple
# rather than applied in memory.
data "apple_app_store_versions" "all" {
  app_id   = data.apple_apps.example.apps[0].id
  platform = "IOS"
}

# The common use: find the version currently being prepared, so a localization
# or review detail can be attached to a release this configuration did not
# create.
data "apple_app_store_versions" "editable" {
  app_id            = data.apple_apps.example.apps[0].id
  platform          = "IOS"
  app_version_state = "PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION"
}

# The most recent release. Sort by created_date rather than version_string:
# version strings are compared as text, so "1.10" sorts before "1.9".
data "apple_app_store_versions" "latest" {
  app_id     = data.apple_apps.example.apps[0].id
  platform   = "IOS"
  sort_by    = "created_date"
  sort_order = "desc"
  limit      = 1
}

output "editable_version_id" {
  value = try(data.apple_app_store_versions.editable.versions[0].id, null)
}

output "latest_version_string" {
  value = try(data.apple_app_store_versions.latest.versions[0].version_string, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The Apple ID of the app whose versions to list.

### Optional

- `app_version_state` (String) Return only versions in this state, for example `PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION`, `IN_REVIEW` or `READY_FOR_DISTRIBUTION`. Matched exactly, case-insensitively.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of versions to return. Applied after filtering and sorting.
- `platform` (String) Return only versions for this platform: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `TV_OS` or `VISION_OS`. Applied by Apple, not in memory.
- `sort_by` (String) Field to sort by: `version_string`, `created_date`, `app_version_state` or `platform`. Sort by `created_date` with `sort_order` `desc` for the most recent release first — `version_string` is compared as text, so `1.10` sorts before `1.9`.
- `sort_order` (String) Sort direction: `asc` or `desc`. Defaults to `asc`.
- `version_string_pattern` (String) Return only versions whose version string matches this regular expression, matched as a substring unless anchored — `^2\.` for the 2.x releases.

### Read-Only

- `filtered_count` (Number) Number of versions remaining after filtering, before the limit.
- `total_count` (Number) Number of versions Apple returned before the in-memory filters.
- `versions` (Attributes List) The versions matching the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `app_id` (String) The Apple ID of the app this version belongs to.
- `app_version_state` (String) Where the version stands.
- `copyright` (String) The copyright line shown on the product page.
- `created_date` (String) When Apple created the version record.
- `downloadable` (Boolean) Whether the version is currently downloadable.
- `earliest_release_date` (String) When a `SCHEDULED` release goes live.
- `id` (String) The unique Apple-generated identifier for the version.
- `platform` (String) The platform this version targets.
- `release_type` (String) How the version is released once approved: `MANUAL`, `AFTER_APPROVAL` or `SCHEDULED`.
- `review_type` (String) Which review queue the version goes through.
- `uses_idfa` (Boolean) Whether the version uses the Advertising Identifier.
- `version_string` (String) The version number customers see.
